channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: This Wednesday: Claremont Stadium Club Night
item.description: Two big Grade 6 Mixed fixtures at Claremont this Wednesday: Navan A in a must-win league match vs Ardee, and Navan B in a knockout cup tie vs Athboy/Kells. Members’ courts open from 8:30pm.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Monday Club Night: Fixtures, Courts & Juvenile Times
item.description: Shake off the Monday blues with Monday Club Night: Navan vs ESB (Division 3 Ladies), Navan vs Longwood ‘B’ (Grade 5 Men’s), 2 member courts from 9pm, plus Juvenile sessions (Girls 6:30pm, Boys 7:30pm).
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Monday Club Night + Cup Match: Navan ‘B’ vs Kildalkey
item.description: Monday Club Night with a Grade 6 Ladies cup match (Navan ‘B’ vs Kildalkey), two member courts from 8:30pm, and Juvenile Club sessions for girls (6:30pm) and boys (7:30pm).
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Exciting Night at Claremont Stadium
item.description: Join us for an open night at Claremont Stadium with all courts available and support our teams in their semi-finals!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Wednesday Navan Badminton Club Update
item.description: No Club Night due to no available courts, but exciting matches are on with our Grade 7 Mixed 'A' team in the semi-final and Juvenile Club Night in full swing.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)
